newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains cattle trade quiet, no sales - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains cattle trade quiet, no sales - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle markets near midday Wednesday remained quiet, with no sales reported, feedlot sources said.
Packers persisted in bidding $66.00 per cwt, sources said. The bids were passed by owners asking $68.00 to $69.00.
Sales were expected later Wednesday or Thursday.

Packers were said to have adequate cattle supplies for this week's slaughter needs and could afford to wait until late this week before buying cattle for next week's operations, they said. Some feedlot managers said they will be working on Good Friday and sales then were possible.
